cases.question: What was Priya Sharma's complete career trajectory from January 2025 through October 2025?

From the beginning of Project Chronos in January 2025 until its final production deployment on 28 July 2025, Priya Sharma was a core member of the Chronos team, contributing to the development of the telemetry system. After the deployment, she concluded her Chronos duties and entered a planned two‑month research rotation (August–September 2025) focused on symbolic knowledge representations. On 10 October 2025, she completed that sabbatical and officially joined Project Nexus as Lead Neuro‑Symbolic Model Engineer, where she began bridging PyTorch tensor embeddings with Neo4j entity graphs.
